name: servicem8
description: Connect ServiceM8 to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use ServiceM8 MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect ServiceM8 to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with field service jobs using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my ServiceM8 workspace.
Find anything in ServiceM8 that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review field service jobs in ServiceM8.
